QuestInfo.name: [Fantasy Theme World] Sensor Recovery
QuestInfo.1: The caped mascot won't say a peep until you help him with his monster problem. Go to #bExtreme Station <3>#k and defeat #r#o8145006##k x150.\r\n
QuestInfo.2: (The caped mascot responded negatively to Dylan's explanation. What did he say?)

0.msg:
#i4036091#
This is what you're looking for, right? I was about to leave it with the information desk.

You know... you really should be more careful with something so important to you. What's so special about it anyway? Is it valuable?

1.msg: #b(This brooch might just be more trouble than it's worth.)#k

2.msg: Oh, that won't really be necessary! It's not valuable at all!! Heh, heh... heh.... You see, I have an immense crush on a wonderful girl named Delilah, and my new best friend here is helping me profess my love to her today!! Aren't you, buddy? That brooch you have there is just a simple gift to help win her affection! Just a plain, ordinary, boring ribbon brooch. That's all... nothing you'd be interested in.

3.msg: I see. I guess this must just be a frivolous luxury item after all.

5.msg: Frivolous?! I'll have you know this is made with advanced technology! I can check Delilah's heartbeat with this. If I wait until her heart is beating quickly, then profess my love for her, she'll mistakenly think her heart is pounding because she likes me. That is why we're looking for thrilling rides to make her heart race.

6.msg: Oh! Really? You should have said so in the first place! I work here, so I know just the thing. It's the most thrilling place here, and it's called the Crittertorium.

7.msg: Huh? I missed that last thing you said, but no thank you anyway. I won't be distracted today. I'm following my ingenious and ultimately flawless plan!

8.msg: But, I thought you said you wanted something scary...

9.msg: #b(The best move now is to just leave with the ribbon brooch.)#k

10.msg: How about a trade? Since I so kindly found your lost brooch for you, you wouldn't mind helping a friend out by getting rid of those bothersome #r#o8145006##k monsters nearby, would you? I'll return this to you if you defeat, say, #b150#k?

yes.0: It's just waiting for strong heroes like yourselves!

no.0: I'll only give it to you if you help me out with a problem.

default.0: #r#o8145006##k #bx150#k, okay? I'll be right here waiting.
